title: Lodge a complaint with Anti-Discrimination NSW
summary: You can lodge a complaint with Anti-Discrimination NSW if you believe you have experienced discrimination, sexual harassment, vilification, or victimisation.
intro:
If you believe that you have experienced discrimination, sexual harassment, vilification or victimisation, you can make a complaint to Anti-Discrimination NSW.

A copy of your complaint and any information you provide will be shared with the person or organisation you are complaining about.

You can lodge a complaint online, by email or post.

Note: Not all discrimination is unlawful. Before lodging a complaint, we recommend that you:
who_can_apply: Individual or group who has been discriminated against, sexually harassed, vilified, or victimised.
A parent, guardian, or carer, or representative body can lodge the complaint on behalf of the individual, provided the representative names the individual and confirms agreement.
what_you_need: A completed online or paper Anti-Discrimination NSW complaint form.
Copies of any supporting documents (if applicable).

more_info.text: Most complaints are resolved within 5 months, but some complaints will be fast-tracked if they require urgent action, for example, if someone is about to lose their job.
Complaints older than 12 months can be declined unless there is a very good reason for the delay.
The complaint process is confidential – anything said or done cannot be used in any related court or tribunal proceeding.
For more information, contact Anti-Discrimination NSW.

external_links.text: How to make a complaint – Anti-Discrimination NSW

faqs.q: What types of incidents can I complain about?
faqs.a: You can make a complaint if you believe you have experienced discrimination, sexual harassment, vilification, or victimisation.

You can make a complaint if you are an individual or group who has been discriminated against, sexually harassed, vilified, or victimised. A parent, guardian, carer, or representative body can also lodge it on your behalf.

faqs.q: How can I lodge a complaint?
faqs.a: You can lodge a complaint online, by email, or by post.
